s01808.summary: Every leaf in the hydroponics ring turns toward the aft bulkhead; Isolde demands explanation.
Sensors show no breach while Feodor's panel glows; officers debate what lies behind the bulkhead.
Kai says the walls have been singing; Nadia shows the plants growing rapidly toward it.
A seam of light spreads through the aft bulkhead and Nadia calls it alive.
Kai hears the echo say hello and lonely; a tendril gently touches him.
Isolde orders the corridor sealed and tasks Nadia to learn what it wants.

s01764.summary: A crew descends a space elevator tether, trading dry banter.
Sven wants to tell the cable story; Idris refuses and Noor sides with Sven.
Sven reveals the stars are fixed because the descent dial is a looped recording.
Idris admits a tether fault and that he hid it to prevent panic.
As the cable sings, Idris lets Sven tell his story and he offers Fumiko tea.

s02218.summary: Attorney Cora presses client Lily on her whereabouts and Brenda's contradicting account.
Lily claims she only moved the four million back after Brenda took it first.
Lily asks if Cora thinks her guilty; Cora calls her merely interesting.
As Cora leaves, Lily says she holds logs proving the time in her head.

s01745.summary: Abel locks himself into the linen basement, recording and checking every corner with his gun.
He finds an envelope with a note from the dead night clerk.
Behind towels he finds a hidden steel door and shoots out the lock.
Abel descends the dark stairwell to a sub-basement church while an organ plays.

s00297.summary: Del and Toby barricade the freezer door against thudding from outside.
The bulb dies and a wet scraping approaches in the dark; a gentle voice calls Del.
Drowned Sabine floats in, freezing the room; Toby's swing passes through her.
The door bursts open to morning crew; Sabine vanishes and the ice melts.

s02263.summary: Colette calls a team meeting and overhears Shanice grumbling.
Colette and Barry tell Shanice her position is eliminated today.
Shanice announces her firing to the floor and everyone ducks out of sight.

s01440.summary: Dr. Imogen and nurse Felix ease Harlan with banter before his procedure.
Imogen finds a blockage and places a stent as Nadia knits anxiously.
Monitors spike and Harlan's pressure drops; they rush to defibrillate.
His heartbeat returns; Imogen admits she is calm when terrified.
Imogen nods to Nadia at the window, who resumes knitting; Harlan murmurs Ohio.

s00904.summary: Widow Esther presses her pale lodger for his name; he gives it as Calloway.
Esther closes the wardrobe and leaves; Calloway reopens it.

s02234.summary: Teague and townsfolk crouch on a saloon roof as a gang rides in.
Guns crack while Hollis toasts the sky and drinks.

s02151.summary: Agent Tamsin crosses an abandoned carousel as Odalys guides her by phone.
The carousel spins up and Tamsin sees a bound girl, Mara.
Tamsin counts fifteen horses, one breathing, and raises her pistol at it.

s00671.summary: Family gathers for Kiki's birthday photo at the roller rink.
Kiki asks about Mom; Dante's mutter sparks conflict until Odalys slaps the table.
Dante says he texted Mom; her reply shows she is parking.
Kiki runs to the door and Odalys lights candles for the song.

s00068.summary: Four survivors on a raft ration a thimble of rainwater.
Tibby hooks a fish and everyone tangles hauling it into the raft.
They whisper dinner and Rosalind smiles for the first time.

s01623.summary: Walter bursts in warning of the fire inspector while Gloria keeps hammering.
Walter douses the smoking badger Gloria gave a cigar, ruining her best piece.
Gloria puts the owl on Walter and sends him to face the inspector.
The door chimes; they primp and the inspector enters.

s01643.summary: Attorney Philomena begins a deposition with reluctant foreman Cornelius.
Under questioning, Cornelius admits the railing was broken and reported four times.
Cornelius fears losing his pension; Philomena says the widow is next door.
After pacing and slamming the table, Cornelius asks to restart the recording and testifies.

s01188.summary: At dawn camp Hilda cooks, Solveig reads the map and Jamal reports weather.
A slip about 'she' and a third rope makes Hilda and Solveig realize something is wrong.
Hilda tells Jamal there was no third climber; a woman's voice calls from the ice.

s02420.summary: Coach Ines watches Dov roll short balls on the rooftop bocce court.
Ines gently takes Dov's ball and tells him to eat, noticing no one has come for him.
Kalani rolls a perfect shot; Dov mutters lucky and Ines calls the last end.
Ines says Dov's father called the club line and she told him they are closed.
Dov rolls close to the pallino and Kalani quietly hands him the shoelace.

s00930.summary: Staff hide in the hospital laundry between shifts, trading small talk and tea.
Young orderly Kestutis asks Dr. Voss whether the work gets easier.
They let a home-run broadcast fill the silence after her honest answer.

s00261.summary: Four travellers converge at a shrine, comparing their black feather summons.
A cold wind rises and Arty hears someone approaching.
A girl says she summoned them and offers a bowl of dark water as a promise.
Something huge exhales in the mist and the girl says that is what they are for.
The four drink one by one and light blooms from the cairn.
The unnamed girl thanks them and walks into the pines as they ready weapons.

s00274.summary: A family and a drenched stranger silently listen as the Coast Guard radios the lighthouse.
Arne rises to answer; Maren stops him and Helga commands him to sit.
Basil grabs the microphone to answer and Helga blocks him.
Basil sees Arne's rope burn, realizes he cut the line, and Arne shouts his reasons.
Helga reports the lighthouse secure; Basil reveals only one survivor.
Silent family wounds remain while the lamp keeps turning.

s02503.summary: A pale woman appears in the greenhouse dome, claiming she did not come by ship.
She shows knowledge of Oskar's dead wife and the buried letter; he names Nerissa.
Oskar lunges for the alarm and Nerissa pins him, saying she is the greenhouse.
Nerissa says the air is breathable, the models were hers, and she is leaving.
She walks into the red desert as Oskar begs and the seedlings turn after her.

s01762.summary: Violet explores the abandoned ice cream factory, reading a clipboard and checking an empty vat.
She finds a frozen wristwatch under the ice and a freezer door ajar.
Her recorder plays a sentence she never said, warning she stands before door nine.
Door nine closes; Violet walks steadily out as freezer latches click open behind her.
Violet leaves her recorder running in the aisle in case anyone wants to know.

s02493.summary: Market workers go about the early morning while an undercover cop watches.
Harlan sees the wire; Kendra spots Greer's badge.
Toby shoves the cart into Greer; roses fly and the bell rings.
Greer draws and points at Kendra, freezing everyone.

s01708.summary: Gino and Trevor receive a late stranger who gives his name as Ellis.
Gino reminds Ellis he owes and tells him to pay.
Ellis reaches into his coat and lays down a thick envelope; Gino counts it.

s01166.summary: Frozen Caleb follows a wary woman across the lake, begging for help.
She tosses him a flask of schnapps and he gives his name.
The ice cracks; she orders Caleb flat and he asks her name; she says Ines.
They crawl to shore as the ice sheet splits and sinks behind them.
They silently pass the flask and listen to the lake fall quiet.
